name: Soyuz T-3
about: Soyuz T-3 (1980-094A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1980 Nov 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1980 Nov 28), held fixed
docked to S10382; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
